title: Merchandise Purchases — Fulfilment Status Recording and Lapse of Returns
content:
**Recording.** Shipment, delivery, pickup, receipt of returns and lapse of returns of Merchandise Purchases units are recorded by Marlowe & Finch systems from carrier scans, register transactions and returns-center inspection; customer care never records them.

**Completed date.** The completed date is the carrier delivery date for ship to home, the date of collection for store pickup, the completed delivery date for home delivery, and the purchase date for carry-out.

**Receipt of a return.** A unit in return pending becomes returned when it is received at a store or the returns center in the condition its class requires.

**Lapse or rejection.** A unit in return pending goes back to completed when the class's label validity period passes after the return was authorized without the label being used or the pickup completed (the return then shows as expired), or when inspection rejects it (the return shows as rejected) and it is shipped back to the customer. A rejected or expired return can be started again only while the unit is still within its return deadline.

## Completed date by fulfilment

| Fulfilment | Completed date |
|---|---|
| ship to home | carrier delivery date |
| store pickup | date of collection |
| home delivery | completed delivery date |
| carry-out | purchase date |

## Return status — what the records show next

| Starting status | Event recorded by the systems | Resulting status |
|---|---|---|
| return pending | received and accepted | returned |
| return pending | label validity period passes unused | completed (return expired) |
| return pending | rejected on inspection and shipped back | completed (return rejected) |

## Hypothetical case

A return of a unit in a class with a 30-day label validity is authorized on 4 April; the mail label is never used. Once the 30 days after 4 April have passed, the return shows as expired and the unit is back in completed status. A new return may then be started only if the unit is still within its return deadline.
